name: Tenjou Rio
source:
One of the two candidate successors of the Tenjo family. She has lived in England for a very long time due to circumstances caused by her parents. She masters in [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fencing]fencing[/url], more particularly in the discipline of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89p%C3%A9e]épée[/url].

She is the cousin of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2721]Kikyou[/url].

[spoiler]Rio is a nice girl from the West, impulsive and proud of herself, the exact opposite of her cousin [url=https://vndb.org/c2721]Kikyou[/url]. After her first defeat against her because of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url]'s kiss, she decides to live with him for having a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agoge]Spartan training life[/url] at his side.

Naive, she executes all the orders that [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] gives her without thinking and without realizing that he is just kidding.[/spoiler]
